title: Aitchison Embeddings for Learning Compositional Graph Representations
abstract: arXiv:2605.00716v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Representation learning is central to graph machine learning, powering tasks such as link prediction and node classification. However, most graph embeddings are hard to interpret, offering limited insight into how learned features relate to graph structure. Many networks naturally admit a role-mixture view, where nodes are best described as mixtures over latent archetypal factors. Motivated by this structure, we propose a compositional graph embedding framework grounded in Aitchison geometry, the canonical geometry for comparing mixtures. Nodes are represented as simplex-valued compositions and embedded via isometric log-ratio (ILR) coordinates, which preserve Aitchison distances while enabling unconstrained optimization in Euclidean space. translated_title: 用于学习组合图表示的艾奇森嵌入
translated_abstract: 摘要：表示学习是图机器学习的核心，支撑着链接预测和节点分类等任务。然而，大多数图嵌入难以解释，对学习到的特征如何与图结构相关联提供的见解有限。许多网络自然具有角色混合的视角，其中节点最好被描述为潜在原型因素的混合。受此结构启发，我们提出了一种基于艾奇森几何的组合图嵌入框架，该几何是比较混合物的经典几何。节点被表示为单纯形值组合，并通过等距对数比（ILR）坐标进行嵌入，这既保留了艾奇森距离，又允许在欧几里得空间中进行无约束优化。这产生了本质上可解释的嵌入，其几何形状反映了原型之间的相对权衡，并支持在成分限制下的一致性行为；我们考虑了固定和可变原型两种情况。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于艾奇森几何的组合图嵌入框架，通过等距对数比坐标保留距离并实现可解释的节点角色混合表示。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a compositional graph embedding framework grounded in Aitchison geometry, using isometric log-ratio coordinates to preserve distances and enable interpretable node role-mixture representations.
